♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: With Mars in sidereal Gemini energising your 3rd house and the Moon moving through Pisces in your 12th, your mind is fast but your heart wants quiet. Sun and Mercury in Leo light up your 5th house, so creativity and self-expression look strong, yet you may need moments of withdrawal to reset your nerves. Saturn retrograde in Pisces behind you presses for inner maturity and better emotional boundaries.

💼 Career: This Mars–Gemini transit helps with writing, sales, presentations, short-term projects and negotiations. You’ll process information quickly and can handle multiple calls or tasks. But with the Moon in your 12th, background worries or subtle office politics may distract you. Use the Leo 5th house activation to put something bold and original into your work – a unique proposal, a different visual, or a smarter way of explaining data. Avoid reacting to rumours; focus on what you can directly influence.

❤️ Love: Sun–Mercury in your 5th house makes you more flirtatious and expressive, even if you’re feeling slightly drained. If you’re attached, a playful conversation or planning a light-hearted outing can break heavy moods. Singles might feel a pull towards someone outspoken, dramatic, or connected to a hobby or creative circle. Because the Moon is in your 12th, be careful not to idealise someone just because you’re craving escape from daily stress.

💰 Money: Rahu in Aquarius and Ketu in Leo keep nudging you to take unconventional routes to gain, but today the wiser move is to clean up existing accounts. Review subscriptions, lingering payments, or any financial commitments you’ve been avoiding. Jupiter in Cancer through your 4th still favours steady, home-related investments over quick wins. If you’re tempted by a speculative move, set a strict cap and consider it an experiment, not a strategy.

🧘 Advice: Honour the contrast: fast mind, tired soul. Give yourself small mental sprints followed by genuine downtime – even 10 minutes of silence between tasks will keep you effective and less reactive.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your courage is obvious to everyone; today’s real strength is in knowing when to step back so that your next move is sharp, not scattered.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Pisces walks through your 11th house of networks and future plans, while Sun–Mercury in Leo heat up your 4th house of home and emotional foundations. Venus, your ruler, is late in Virgo in your 5th, refining your tastes and standards. You’re pulled between wanting a quiet, secure nest and feeling curious about new communities, collaborations, and long-term visions.

💼 Career: Jupiter in Cancer in your 3rd favours learning, communication, and short courses that directly support your work. Today is good for strategic conversations with colleagues, mentors or peers about where you want to be a year from now. Moon in the 11th highlights group projects and online spaces: a low-key interaction or comment could bring an unexpected opening. Yet, Leo in the 4th suggests that big outer changes in career will feel right only if they respect your need for stability at home – don’t sacrifice basic emotional safety for hype.

❤️ Love: Venus in your 5th makes romance more discerning than impulsive. You’re craving sincerity plus real compatibility, not just attraction. Couples may talk about living arrangements, family dynamics or what “feeling at home” together really means. If you’re single, a connection could arise through friends, social media or a shared interest – notice who makes you feel both relaxed and inspired, not just impressed.

💰 Money: Rahu in Aquarius and Ketu in Leo cut across your 10th–4th axis, keeping career growth and family responsibilities in constant negotiation. Today, Moon in your 11th suggests small but meaningful financial benefit via networks – referrals, recommendations, or information about a better-paying opportunity. Venus in Virgo wants you to refine your approach to spending on leisure, hobbies, or children: quality over quantity will serve you better than trying to “buy” excitement.

🧘 Advice: Before bed, jot down three things that genuinely feel like “success” to you, separate from what others admire. Re-aligning with your own definition will guide better choices over the coming weeks.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your peace of mind is not a luxury item in your career story; it’s the foundation that quietly decides how high you can go.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: Mars in your sign keeps your body and mind active, while the Moon in Pisces sits high in your 10th house, putting emotions into your public role. Sun and your ruler Mercury in Leo highlight your 3rd house of communication, learning, and local movement. You’re in a phase where words carry more weight than usual – what you say and how you say it can change your image quickly.

💼 Career: With the Moon at the top of your chart, even small tasks may be noticed by seniors or clients. The Leo 3rd house charge makes you more persuasive and confident in meetings, pitches, and negotiations. This is excellent for teaching, training, content creation, sales, or any role involving messaging. However, Mars in your 1st can make you impatient; double-check emails and documents so speed doesn’t sacrifice clarity. If a public opportunity arises suddenly, prepare just enough and trust your mind to fill in the rest.

❤️ Love: Communication is the main bridge today. Whether single or attached, you’ll want stimulating conversation and mental connection. The Pisces Moon in your 10th can make you wonder how your relationship fits into your life direction or public image – you may sense where your partnership supports your aspirations and where it feels misaligned. Singles might feel drawn to someone admired in their field, a senior, or someone with a more spiritual or artistic aura.

💰 Money: Jupiter in Cancer in your 2nd quietly supports earnings and savings, but Mars in your 1st increases the urge to act quickly with money – buying tools, tech, or signing up for courses. Choose investments that clearly upgrade your skills or efficiency rather than chasing every shiny option. Rahu in Aquarius across your 9th can bring unusual ideas about foreign investments or higher education; research thoroughly before committing.

🧘 Advice: When you feel pulled in too many directions, pick one interaction that truly matters and be fully present for it. Depth in one conversation today will open more doors than scattering your energy across ten.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your agility is your gift, but your real magic appears when you let one idea – and one message – land with full focus.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon, your ruler, moves through fellow water sign Pisces, brightening your 9th house of beliefs, wisdom and long-distance matters. Sun–Mercury in Leo heat your 2nd house of values and speech, and Jupiter continues to bless your own sign, amplifying your sensitivity and desire for growth. Saturn retrograde in Pisces presses gently on old belief patterns that no longer fit who you are becoming.

💼 Career: Today is well suited for big-picture thinking: strategy, education plans, travel-related affairs, or legal and publishing work. You may feel driven to understand the “why” behind your career choices, not just the “how.” Discussions with mentors, senior colleagues, or foreign clients can be meaningful. With Leo energising your 2nd, you’ll naturally speak more confidently about your skills and worth. Avoid over-promising or turning every conversation into a self-critique; let your work and grounded self-respect speak.

❤️ Love: Pisces Moon in your 9th stirs the romantic idealist in you. You may crave a partner who shares your worldview, faith, or thirst for growth. If you’re already committed, a talk about future directions – travel, study, or spiritual practice together – can deepen connection. Singles might feel attracted to someone from a different culture, city, or background. Just be aware that you may be seeing the potential more than the person; balance faith with observation.

💰 Money: Sun–Mercury in your 2nd highlight income, budgeting, and the link between your self-esteem and financial decisions. You might feel an urge to upgrade certain possessions or your environment to reflect who you are now. Jupiter in your 1st can bring opportunities, but it can also expand spending. Prioritise moves that support learning and emotional security over purchases meant to impress others.

🧘 Advice: Take a few minutes to write down one belief about work or money that you inherited from family or culture, and ask yourself if it truly serves the person you are today.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your intuition has always been strong; the shift now is trusting it enough to choose beliefs that nourish you, not just comfort the past.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: Sun and Mercury are blazing in your own sidereal Leo, intensifying your self-awareness, voice and presence. The Moon in Pisces moves through your 8th house of depth, shared resources, and emotional undercurrents, while Ketu in Leo quietly strips away parts of your identity that no longer feel authentic. You’re both visible and in quiet inner surgery at the same time.

💼 Career: With your Sun strong, others look to you for leadership and decisions. Presentations, interviews, or public-facing tasks can go especially well if you prepare your facts and let your natural warmth handle the rest. The Pisces Moon in the 8th, though, may surface questions about power dynamics, confidentiality, or funding in your professional world. You could sense what’s not being openly discussed – use that insight to navigate cautiously, not to become suspicious of everyone.

❤️ Love: This is a day for emotional honesty. The 8th house Moon wants deeper conversations about trust, intimacy, and what you truly need from partnership, beyond surface gestures. If you’re attached, you may notice where you’ve been over-giving or dramatizing to avoid vulnerability. If you’re single, you might be magnetised to mysterious or complex people. Go slowly; intensity doesn’t always equal long-term fit.

💰 Money: The 8th house transit steers focus to shared finances, loans, taxes, inheritances, or business partnerships. It’s a good day to quietly review agreements, check due dates, and ask clarifying questions where numbers feel vague. Rahu in Aquarius across your 7th can bring unusual clients or collaborators; good boundaries will keep opportunities clean and prevent blurred lines.

🧘 Advice: When you feel the urge to control a situation, pause and ask: “What am I afraid will happen if I simply state my truth and then wait?” Let space do part of the work today.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your light doesn’t dim when you reveal your fears; it deepens, and that depth is what makes others truly trust you.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Pisces travels through your 7th house of one-to-one relationships while your ruler Mercury joins the Sun in Leo in your 12th house. Venus is finishing its transit of your own sign, polishing your self-image and taste. On the surface, you may function well; inwardly, you’re processing unspoken feelings and old patterns in love and partnership.

💼 Career: With Leo in your 12th, you may do your best work behind the scenes right now: research, analysis, planning, and problem-solving that’s not yet public. The Pisces Moon in the 7th can bring emotional tones into client interactions or collaborations – someone may come to you with their worries, expecting you to fix everything. Offer support but avoid taking on more responsibility than is realistic. Saturn in Pisces in your 7th long-term is teaching you to create healthier agreements; today you get a glimpse of where boundaries need reinforcement.

❤️ Love: This is a sensitive relationship day. Couples might feel a mix of compassion and fatigue – you want to be there for your partner, but you also need rest and psychic space. Express that gently instead of silently pulling away. Singles may feel drawn to people who seem wounded or in need of saving; remember that attraction doesn’t equal a mission. Your own healing journey matters as much as anyone else’s.

💰 Money: With your 12th and 7th houses activated, it’s wise to look at any recurring expenses tied to other people: subscriptions you took for someone, shared accounts, or financial help that has quietly become a pattern. Jupiter in Cancer in your 11th still favours long-term gains through sincere networks, not rescue-driven giving. Supporting friends or partners is fine as long as you’re not draining your own reserves.

🧘 Advice: Choose one relationship today – romantic, professional, or familial – and state one small need clearly and kindly. Practicing directness in low-stakes moments builds the muscle for bigger conversations later.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your care is powerful, but it becomes truly healing when it includes you in its circle.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Pisces moves through your 6th house of routines, health and service, while Sun–Mercury in Leo energise your 11th house of friendships, communities and long-term aspirations. Venus, your ruler, in Virgo in the 12th makes you more reflective and selective about where you pour your affection and creativity. Social energy is present, but it’s linked strongly to how you manage your daily life.

💼 Career: This is a practical-progress day. The 6th house Moon helps you tune into small details at work – schedules, files, systems, and how your body responds to your workload. Sun–Mercury in the 11th favour team discussions, community projects, and planning around your wider career goals. It’s a good time to connect with people who can realistically support your ambitions, not just cheer them. Avoid people-pleasing by saying “yes” to every group request; choose the collaborations that truly align.

❤️ Love: Venus in the 12th can stir past relationship memories or a craving for a quieter, more soulful connection. You may be less interested in glamorous romance and more in feeling understood in your vulnerabilities. If attached, doing something small but considerate for your partner’s daily comfort – and allowing them to support you in return – strengthens the bond. Singles might notice hidden attractions in their friend circle or workplace; stay aware of boundaries and timing.

💰 Money: With the 6th and 11th active, focus on how habits impact income. Small, consistent efforts – tracking hours, following up on invoices, tidying digital clutter – could prevent financial leaks. Rahu in Aquarius in your 5th might occasionally push you toward riskier speculation or trying to impress others through spending. Ground yourself by remembering your bigger plans: experiences and stability carry more value than fleeting displays.

🧘 Advice: Pick one simple system to tidy today – your inbox, task list or budget sheet. Clearing just that space will make decisions about people and plans feel lighter.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Harmony with others feels sweetest when your own daily life supports, rather than sabotages, the future you’re building.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Pisces visits your 5th house of creativity, joy, children and romance, while Sun–Mercury in Leo occupy your 10th house of career and reputation. Mars, your ruler, in Gemini moves through your 8th house, pushing you toward deeper work and psychological transformation. You’re in a mood to express more of your hidden talents, but there’s also a seriousness about what legacy you’re constructing.

💼 Career: With Leo high in your chart, there’s a spotlight on your professional identity. You may be asked to take charge, present an idea, or make a judgement call. The Pisces 5th house Moon adds imagination and intuitive flair – excellent for creative problem-solving, design, teaching, or any work requiring empathy. But Mars in the 8th can intensify reactions around money, power or shared resources at work. If you sense tension, address it calmly rather than trying to control everything behind the scenes.

❤️ Love: Emotionally, you’re more playful and expressive today, yet there’s an undercurrent of vulnerability from Mars in the 8th. Couples could have heartfelt moments around children, creative pursuits, or simply allowing more fun into a relationship that’s become too serious. If there are deeper fears about trust or betrayal, they may surface indirectly – watch for tone rather than just words. Singles might be drawn to someone artistic or spiritually inclined, but you’ll still scan beneath the surface before fully opening up.

💰 Money: Mars in your 8th keeps finances linked to others very active – joint accounts, loans, shared investments, inheritances, or business backing. You might feel like pushing aggressively for a certain deal or repayment; try a strategic, step-by-step approach instead of ultimatums. Sun–Mercury in the 10th asks you to consider how financial decisions affect your professional image. Say yes only to arrangements that you’d be comfortable having discussed openly.

🧘 Advice: When intensity rises, channel it into one purposeful task – drafting a proposal, researching an investment, or planning a creative project – instead of replaying worst-case scenarios in your head.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your depth is a gift, but when you direct it toward creation instead of control, your impact multiplies.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Pisces moves through your 4th house of home and inner emotional security, while Sun–Mercury in Leo light up your 9th house, your natural domain of wisdom, travel and expansion. Jupiter in Cancer in your 8th continues to deepen your emotional and financial transformation. Outwardly you’re drawn to big horizons; inwardly, old feelings and family themes are being re-arranged.

💼 Career: The 9th house activation favours work involving education, law, publishing, consulting, and international connections. You may feel inspired to pitch a new direction, course, or project that aligns more with your principles. Yet the Pisces Moon in the 4th can make you extra sensitive to what’s happening at home; mood at your base will colour your professional performance. If there is domestic tension, carve out a small ritual – a walk, a quiet corner – before major meetings to reset your emotional tone.

❤️ Love: You might be craving both adventure and emotional reassurance today. Couples could discuss future relocation, travel, or study plans and how these fit with family or living arrangements. Honest but gentle communication will keep dreams from becoming arguments. Singles may feel drawn to someone foreign, philosophical, or linked to a learning environment, but you’ll only feel safe moving forward if your gut feels calm, not anxious, around them.

💰 Money: With Jupiter in the 8th, you’re in a longer cycle of reassessing shared finances, debts and deeper commitments. Today’s Moon in the 4th suggests looking at how financial choices affect your sense of home and emotional safety. Sun–Mercury in the 9th may bring opportunities connected to teaching, global clients or legal matters; read all terms carefully before committing. A measured step toward financial education or expert advice could pay off.

🧘 Advice: When your mind races toward distant possibilities, briefly bring attention to your actual physical surroundings – your breath, your seat, the room. A grounded body makes for wiser long-range decisions.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your vision naturally extends far, but the power of that vision depends on how solid you feel in the space you stand in today.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Pisces moves through your 3rd house of communication, siblings, and short trips, while Sun–Mercury in Leo occupy your 8th house of shared assets, transformation and intimacy. Saturn, your ruler, retrograde in Pisces presses you to refine how you think and speak. You’re more aware of what lies beneath the words – your own and others’.

💼 Career: Today favours research, confidential work, analysis and behind-the-scenes coordination. The 8th house Sun–Mercury combination can highlight sensitive topics at work – budgets, contracts, restructuring, or performance reviews. You’re positioned to handle these with seriousness and discretion, which others will value. The Pisces Moon in your 3rd helps you listen between the lines, but be careful not to absorb everyone else’s stress. Frame questions clearly and keep written records where stakes are high.

❤️ Love: Emotional intimacy and honest conversations about fears, loyalty, and long-term plans are supported. You may feel the need to reveal something you’ve been holding back – a concern about money, family, or past hurts. Do it gently, without assuming the worst outcome. Singles might feel attracted to someone who has a complex background or a deep, almost magnetic presence; take your time exploring whether they share your values, not just your intensity level.

💰 Money: Shared finances, loans, taxes, or partner’s income are highlighted. It’s a good day to review documents, clarify who is responsible for what, and make a realistic repayment or savings plan. Rahu in Aquarius in your 2nd has been shaking up your personal income and spending patterns; combining its inventive energy with sober planning from Saturn can help you design smarter earning strategies rather than simply worrying.

🧘 Advice: When you feel a heavy topic forming in your mind, write down the main point and one outcome you’d like before starting the conversation. Structure will keep you from spiralling and help others understand you.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: You’re built to carry responsibility, but you’re allowed to share the truth of that weight so it doesn’t quietly harden your heart.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Pisces travels through your 2nd house of income, speech and self-worth, while Sun–Mercury in Leo shine from your 7th house of partnerships. Rahu remains in your sign, pushing you to reinvent yourself, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 2nd slowly reshapes your relationship to security and resources. Other people’s reactions are mirroring how you currently value yourself.

💼 Career: With Leo in your 7th, collaborative work, client relations, and negotiations are in the foreground. You may be dealing with strong personalities or people who want attention and clear answers. The Pisces Moon in your 2nd makes your tone and choice of words especially important; even small comments can affect how others perceive your professionalism and worth. This is a good day for honest fee discussions, setting clearer terms, or gently but firmly stepping away from arrangements that drain you.

❤️ Love: Relationship themes are loud. Couples may discuss fairness, commitment, or shared goals; sunlight is entering corners where expectations were unspoken. Try not to default to detachment when emotions rise – a bit of warmth and directness will resolve far more than intellectual debate. Singles could meet someone confident and expressive who challenges their usual cool approach. Notice how your body feels around them – relaxed, or on edge? Use that as data.

💰 Money: Saturn and the Moon in your 2nd ask for realism: what is actually coming in, what is going out, and how do your spending choices reflect your current identity? It’s not about deprivation; it’s about congruence. Sun–Mercury in your 7th can bring chances for partnership-based earnings or contracts, but read details carefully. Only align financially with people whose ethics and style you respect.

🧘 Advice: Practice stating one clear boundary today, even in a small area – your work hours, a payment timeline, or a personal preference. Each precise limit you express strengthens your inner sense of worth.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Reinvention isn’t just about changing how you look; it’s about teaching the world, through your choices, how you deserve to be treated.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Moon is in your own sign, heightening sensitivity and intuition, while Sun–Mercury in Leo light up your 6th house of work, health and daily rhythms. Saturn retrograde travelling through Pisces alongside the Moon reminds you that emotional waves need structure, not suppression. You may feel both inspired and weighed down – like you sense the next chapter but are still tying up loose ends.

💼 Career: With Leo in your 6th, there’s a spotlight on how you show up day-to-day – reliability, organisation, and the way you handle responsibilities. This is a strong transit for refining routines, delegating better, and taking pride in the quality of your work, even in small tasks. The Moon in your 1st can make you more reactive to criticism or office moods; pause before assuming that every comment is personal. Quietly adjusting one inefficient habit today could have a big cumulative impact.

❤️ Love: You’re extra permeable to others’ emotions, especially your partner’s. That can be a blessing for empathy, but draining if you try to fix everything. Share what you’re feeling instead of expecting your partner to intuit it automatically. Singles may project fantasies onto new interests very quickly under this Moon; slow down, observe actions over time, and keep some emotional space for yourself while things are new.

💰 Money: Leo in the 6th encourages you to take your craft seriously, which over time improves earnings. Today is good for reviewing your schedule, identifying unproductive time sinks, and considering what skills you might polish to become more valuable in your field. With Saturn in your sign and Jupiter in Cancer in your 5th, long-term finances improve through disciplined use of your creativity, not through shortcuts or excessive sacrifice.

🧘 Advice: Ground your day with one simple physical routine – stretching, a walk, or a consistent mealtime. Let your body be the anchor around which your changing feelings can safely move.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your sensitivity is not an obstacle to a stable life; it becomes your compass when you give it structure to work within.
